events.name: Fireside with Hans Robertson, Verkada
events.description:
South Park Commons is delighted to host Hans Robertson, Executive Chairman and Co-Founder of Verkada for a fireside chat. 

Hans Robertson is executive chairman and co-founder of Verkada, a leader in cloud-based physical security solutions. Founded in 2016 with just four employees, Hans has helped scale Verkada to more than 2,200 employees, 31,000 enterprise customers, and a valuation of $5.8 billion. Today, Hans leads Verkada’s daily operations in partnership with Verkada’s CEO, Filip Kaliszan.
Prior to Verkada, Hans co-founded another Silicon Valley Unicorn, Meraki, where he served as chief operating officer for almost a decade. During this time, he helped design the first cloud-managed enterprise networking products – including Wi-Fi, firewall, and switching systems – and led the company to a $1.2 billion acquisition with Cisco in 2012.
Prior to founding Meraki he was a product manager at EMC and was an early employee at VMware. Hans began his career as a business analyst at McKinsey & Co. Hans also serves as a Board member at Pilot and Tractian. Hans holds a bachelor’s and master’s degree in computer science from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT).

*This event is OTR*
About South Park Commons (SPC)
SPC is a technical community and venture fund dedicated to helping founders, researchers, and technologists figure out what to work on next—what we call the -1 to 0 stage of your career. We believe this is best accomplished in the most talent-dense community possible.
SPC events are open to members, alumni, and special guests of the community. The best way to join events at SPC is to apply for SPC membership.
